violated_contract: When a released server answers a legitimate no-result outcome with an error status (the firmware lookup's 404 "No suitable firmware update found for your device version." for a device already on the newest release), the client must read that specific answer as the outcome it states. Treating every non-200 as a failed request tells a correct state as an error and sends owners to support or to manual workarounds, while other statuses and details stay failures.
canonical_prevention: Classify the response once at the API boundary into result, documented no-result, and failure, matching the no-result answer on status plus its exact detail, and test the no-result answer beside adjacent statuses and details (offline, 5xx, other 404s, 400) that must remain failures.
